mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a critical thinker and problem solver, a self-directed learner and an effective communicator."
A health educated person is a critical thinker and problem solver, a self-directed learner and an effective communicator.

Simulations are one of the most complex interactive media for learning.

Non-projected visual displays are the backbone of the whole range of classroom visual materials.
